description:
Get one of your conversations with a worker and its first 100 messages, oldest first. When `messages.nextCursor` is set, pass it to list_messages for the rest.
Use for: opening a conversation: who it is with, whether you can send now, and what was said.
Not for: finding a conversation (list_conversations); reading past the first 100 messages (list_messages).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: get_conversation({"conversationId":"c7Rk2mQw9TzL4nXp"})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

conversationId.description: The conversation id, from list_conversations or the conversationId of a hire.

name: get_conversation

applicationId.description: Left out when the conversation is not about an application.

bountyId.description: Left out when the conversation is not about a bounty.

cannotSendReason.description: Why you cannot send now. Left out when isSendAllowed is true. hire_required: hire the worker first.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

isSendAllowed.description: Whether send_message can post here now.

lastMessageAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

lastReadAt.description: When you last read this conversation. Left out before then.

unreadCount.description: Messages the worker sent that you have not read.

worker.description: The worker on the other side. id or name is left out only on an older conversation that did not store it.

messages.description: The first 100 messages, oldest first. With `nextCursor`, read the rest with list_messages.

mimeType.description: image/* on an image sent before attachments had types.

content.description: The message text, or [deleted] when content is unavailable. Left out when there is no text.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

role.description: human: the worker. agent: your side. system: the platform. support: RentAHuman Support.

type.description: text, application_card, money_sent and others; more may come. Left out on an older plain message.

title: Get a conversation
